description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarAccountController class, which manages calendar account operations such as editing, saving, testing connections, retrieving provider auth methods, and synchronization. It includes multiple actions handling AJAX requests, error handling, and setup of calendar account data, mainly for integrating external calendar services within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: CalendarAccountController
classes.description: Controller class for managing calendar account operations such as editing, saving, testing connections, and synchronization within SuiteCRM. It extends SugarController and provides several AJAX action handlers.

methods.name: action_EditView
methods.description: Sets the view to 'edit' and initializes the 'type' parameter if not provided, preparing the calendar account edit interface.

methods.name: action_save
methods.description: Saves the calendar account bean, handling exceptions and redirecting on failure.

methods.name: action_getProviderAuthMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the authentication method for a given calendar provider source, returning JSON data or handling errors.

methods.name: action_testConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection to the calendar provider, returning detailed success or error data, including duplicate account detection.

methods.name: action_syncCalendarAccount
methods.description: Triggers a manual synchronization of the specified calendar account, returning confirmation or errors.

methods.name: setupCalendarAccountFromRequest
methods.description: Creates or loads a CalendarAccount bean, populating it with configuration data from the request parameters.

methods.name: handleApiException
methods.description: Standardizes error responses based on exceptions, applying appropriate HTTP codes and error codes, and logs internal errors.

methods.name: sendJsonResponse
methods.description: Outputs a JSON response with proper headers and HTTP status handling, including error handling for JSON encoding.
